messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

Thank you for providing that information. I can see the issue - Airplane Mode is currently ON, which disables all wireless communications including cellular service. This is why you have no signal.

Let's start by turning off Airplane Mode. Could you please use the **toggle_airplane_mode** command on your phone to turn Airplane Mode OFF?

Please run that command and let me know when it's done.

Airplane Mode is now off, but I see that mobile data is still disabled on my phone. Should I go ahead and enable mobile data next?

Please complete the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
